item.title: Two events in a single day? Homa finishes Cognizant final round, runs off to TGL
item.description: Jupiter Links GC and Boston Common Golf in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, on Sunday night is far from your average TGL matchup. Jupiter's Max Homa and Tom Kim will be just a few hours removed from playing 18 holes of competitive golf at PGA National.

item.title: Cognizant Classic 2026 prize money: Here's how much Nico Echavarria nets from $9.6 million purse
item.description: Here's how the Cognizant Classic's $9.6 million purse will be paid out to the field, including winner Nico Echavarria.

item.title: Podcast: Previewing Darius Rucker Intercollegiate; interview with event's namesake
item.description: Burko and Brentley are together again, this time at Long Cove Club ahead of the Darius Rucker Intercollegiate.

item.title: Nico Echavarria wins Cognizant Classic with flawless weekend after Shane Lowry melts down late
item.description: Shane Lowry entered the week as co-favorite with Ryan Gerard and was smothering the competition through 15 holes Sunday. Back-to-back double bogeys flipped the script, and Nico Echavarria took advantage to win at PGA National.

item.title: Lowry on Cognizant defeat: 'Had the tournament in my hands and threw it away'
item.description: Shane Lowry spoke to reporters moments after a crushing defeat at PGA National. Lowry was in control of the leaderboard until back-to-back double bogeys on the 16th and 17th holes. The collapse gave way to Nico Echavarria to win the 2026 Cognizant Classic, his third win on the PGA Tour.

item.title: Echavarria on third career win: 'Sometimes you have to have good breaks'
item.description: Nico Echavarria took advantage of Shane Lowry's meltdown on the final three holes at PGA National to win his third event on the PGA Tour.

item.title: Shane Lowry on Cognizant Classic collapse: 'I thought I had it'
item.description: Lowry doubled two of his last three holes on Sunday to lose the Cognizant Classic at PGA National.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Cognizant Classic, final round
item.description: Shane Lowry's consecutive double bogeys on the 16th and 17th hole at PGA National opened the door for a surprise victory. Nico Echavarria won on Tour for the third time in his career, seizing the moment and capturing the Cognizant Classic crown. Max Homa, Brooks Koepka and Max McGreevy all contributed to a highlight-filled Sunday in South Florida. McGreevy's albatross on 3 stunned the field early in the day.
